title: Target affine dictionary
statement:
With the same schemes, qcqs f, flat g and pullback.snd, quasi-coherent F, injective resolutions I,J, degree p, affine V,W with W contained in g inverse V, and restricted resolution data D defined by [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison], [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] and [pqf-def-cohomology], put A=Gamma(S,V), B=Gamma(S',W), U=f inverse V, h=the restriction followed by V's affine chart, N=F restricted to U, P=R^p f_* F, Q=R^p f'_* g'^* F. For every additive eH as above AND every bijective B-linear a satisfying that source pure-tensor normalization, there is a bijective B-linear b from HOver(h_B,N_B,p) to Gamma(Q,W), with b(baseChangeLinear(xi)) equal to restriction to W of D.targetClass(moduleCohomologyFMap(g' restricted,D.psi,p)(eH inverse xi)). The source normalization is a hypothesis, not a conclusion; arbitrary additive eH without a normalized linear lift is excluded.

Exact Lean statement:
theorem Scheme.Modules.exists_flatBaseChange_affine_target
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [Flat g] [Flat (pullback.snd g f)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (eVW : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W) := (g.appLE V W eVW).hom.toAlgebra
    let h := f.resLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫ V.toSpecΓ
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F
    let P := ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerived p).obj F
    let Q := ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).rightDerived p).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)
    ∀ (eH : ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F)) ≃+
          Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p)
      (a : TensorProduct Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W) (Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p) →ₗ[Γ(S', W)]
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj P, W)),
      Function.Bijective a →
      (∀ (s : Γ(S', W)) (xi : Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p),
        a (s ⊗ₜ[Γ(S, V)] xi) = s •
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj P).presheaf.map (homOfLE eVW).op
            (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
              ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).unit.app P)
              V (D.sourceClass p (eH.symm xi)))) →
      ∃ b : Scheme.Modules.HOver (Scheme.Modules.baseChangeSnd (S := Γ(S', W)) h)
          (Scheme.Modules.baseChangedModule (S := Γ(S', W)) h N) p →ₗ[Γ(S', W)]
          Γ(Q, W),
        Function.Bijective b ∧
        (∀ xi : Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p,
          b (Scheme.Modules.H.baseChangeLinear (S := Γ(S', W)) h N p xi) =
            Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE eVW).op
              (D.targetClass p
                (Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyFMap ((pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
                  ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) D.psi p (eH.symm xi))))

source.place: Tags 02KH, 01XJ, 01E4 and 03FD; canonical target comparison and part (2) flat cohomology base change; algebraic transport of a normalized source lift

proof.text: Construct canonical e0,a0,b0 by common section-complex comparisons, affine chart pullbacks, quasi-coherent higher images, affine vanishing and cocycle-normalized Leray. The given D identifies the restricted complexes and maps with their canonical counterparts.

The augmented resolution map computing moduleCohomologyFMap and the Ext inverse-image comparison compute the same map on common section complexes. D.unit_square and chart units identify the coefficient morphisms. Hence b0(baseChangeLinear(y)) is the required target class evaluated on e0 inverse y.

B is flat over A by g.flat_appLE. U is qcqs and N quasi-coherent. Use the separated Cech base-change theorem, then compact-open induction and Mayer-Vietoris gluing, to make c=H.baseChange a B-linear equivalence. No resolution beta or parent dictionary is used.

Convert a to an equivalence and set b=b0 o c o a0 inverse o a o c inverse. Source normalization at s=1 gives a(1 tensor xi)=a0(1 tensor e0(eH inverse xi)). Cancellation and the canonical target compatibility give precisely the conclusion; all factors are bijective and B-linear.
Empty opens and zero coefficients produce zero modules; degree zero uses the same augmentations and cancellation identities.
